verdict.rationale: Verbatim text was extracted from several comptroller.texas.gov guidance pages (file-pay, franchise filing requirements, open-data). The host answered keyless probes with ordinary 404s rather than challenge pages, and the eSystems host sends keyless agents back to that public front door, so the reading surface appears to serve real HTML without a bot wall. There is no explicit probe recording an HTTP 200 on a guidance page with an identified user agent, or confirming the absence of a CAPTCHA or JS-only shell. missing for 10: a direct keyless probe of a guidance page showing a 200 status and server-rendered content, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, and robots.txt or user-agent policy evidence for comptroller.texas.gov.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
